spirits.name: Gaja Calf
spirits.lore: Follows the Perahera drums and naps through the fire dancers.

spirits.name: Malu Sprite
spirits.lore: Lives in temple ponds and nibbles on lotus petals.

spirits.name: Monara Chick
spirits.lore: Practices its tail fan every morning, waiting for rain.

spirits.name: Ura Boarlet
spirits.lore: Roots through the forest floor looking for moonstones.

spirits.name: Simha Cub
spirits.lore: Its roar is still a squeak, but its mane is already ablaze.

spirits.name: Gajasinghe
spirits.lore: Elephant strength, lion heart. Guards the old gateways.

spirits.name: Serapendiya
spirits.lore: Curled-beak bird of Sinhala art, carved on kasthane hilts.

spirits.name: Naga Raksha
spirits.lore: Crowned with cobras, risen from the masks of Ambalangoda.

spirits.name: Gurulu Raksha
spirits.lore: Strikes from the sky with a cobra in its beak.

spirits.name: Makara
spirits.lore: Elephant front, lion feet, boar ear, fish body. Guardian of the thorana.
